snippet.title: HAUNTIFY MULTIPLAYER - GAME UPDATE WINDOW - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Hauntify Multiplayer is a new mixed reality horror experience that lets players invite friends into their scanned real-world house, whether they are playing co-located in the same space or joining from around the world in VR. One player can explore their physical environment in mixed reality while other players enter that same scanned space as allies, enemies, or monsters. The game expands Hauntify’s house-transforming horror gameplay with multiplayer, sandbox play, AI-controlled threats, and player-controlled monster modes. Hauntify Multiplayer is coming soon and is designed to push mixed reality beyond a single-player experience.
